title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.29545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. translated_title: SCRA-CLIP：面向零样本异常检测的球面上下文表示自适应
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型的最新进展通过可迁移的视觉-语义表示推动了零样本异常检测（ZSAD）的发展。然而，由于对多样化异常模式及其空间上下文的建模不足，检测细粒度异常仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SCRA-CLIP，一种球面上下文表示自适应框架，可联合增强异常感知的文本语义和上下文敏感的视觉表示。具体而言，我们引入了球面原型条件化提示，该方法利用von Mises–Fisher混合分布来建模正常与异常图像块特征的方向分布。这些特定状态的原型被融入文本上下文中，以指导学习更具判别性的文本表示。此外，我们开发了上下文偏差引导的视觉自适应，用于捕捉局部特征偏差……
tldr: 提出SCRA-CLIP框架，通过球面原型条件化提示（SPCP）建模正常与异常特征分布以增强文本语义，并结合上下文偏差引导的视觉自适应（CGVA）捕捉空间上下文，显著提升零样本异常检测中的细粒度异常检测能力。
en_tdlr: SCRA-CLIP jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics via Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting and context-sensitive visual representations via Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation, enabling fine-grained zero-shot anomaly detection.
